tests.name: first verified proof commits a single identity/session and durable bound reservation
fresh same authenticated session can recover without another identity/session write; another browser cannot replay
concurrent replay has one reservation winner and one set of downstream writes
widget/mobile exchange share the same proof use; no cross-session alternative route
invalid/expired signatures are refused before replay/identity/session writes
failed login leaves proof claimed; another browser cannot convert uncertainty to another identity write
SQL stores only keyed proof/session bindings, never raw signature, session cookie or initData

scope: Actual proof ledger transactions and authentication flow with synthetic signed credentials; not actual browser/device/production identity proof
